{{MapTabs|Story}} This page contains the official story elements included in [[Bathroom Approach]] of [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== The events in this map take place after the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. Based on the calendar present on the map, it would take place on the 9th of April. The [[Duck Realm]] had its food supplied through a portal, which one day suddenly stopped. As there appears to be no other food source in the [[Duck Realm]], this lead to the population of mostly ducks to go without food for weeks. Throughout these weeks, ducks would occasionally visit the portal to check if it is back up, sometimes leaving notes on it. In April, the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] decides to yet again check to see if the portal works, where he finds out it is still in its broken state. However, he does find an [[God Cube|unknown shard]] near it. After realizing the power that the [[God Cube|shard]] holds, he mobilizes an army of ducks for an attack on the [[T.D.S. Organization]], which he blames for the portal breaking. In preparation for the attack, multiple ducks create various [[Ducky D00M III|mechs]] and [[Bunny Sentry|sentries]] which would be used to defeat the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. One of the mechs would be powered by the [[God Cube|shard]] he found. During the preparations, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] detected that a new [[God Cube]] fragment was in a [[Duck Realm]]. They dispatched the [[Scout]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Soldier]], lead by the [[Dispatcher]], to collect the shard and bring it back to one of the [[T.D.S. Organization|T.D.S.]] bases. After finding it using a [[God Cube]] detector, they run into a group of ducks commanded by the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], which gets them all into a fight. During the fight, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] takes control over the [[Bunny Sentry|Bunny Sentries]] created and uses them to combat the ducks. The [[Dispatcher]] also starts looking into why the portal broke, where she finds out it was caused by [[Children of Exo]]'s recent invasion on [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. The battle ends with the [[T.D.S. Organization]] defeating either a [[God Cube]] powered [[Ducky D00M III]] or [[Nerd Ducky|Mecha Bunny]], then the [[Pyromancer]] and [[Soldier]] take away its [[God Cube]] shard. The [[Scout]], however, decides to approach the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] with the intent of killing him. He eventually spares his life. Afterwards, [[Professor V]] arrives to the dimension. Impressed by [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]]'s work, she offers him to work alongside her, which he agrees to. Later, she also mentions that the portal has been opened again, providing the [[Duck Realm]] with a supply of food again. ==Opening Cutscene== [[File:Ducky Revenge Intro - Tower Defense Simulator Easter 2025 Event|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays when the timer counts down to 0:00 before the match starts. The map has not yet changed, and the player's point of view is changed to a full screen third person view of the cutscene when the cutscene begins. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
A large bathroom populated by ducks is shown. A calendar is shown on the wall which contains multiple writings on it, all about how bread stopped being delivered to the realm. Afterwards, multiple starving ducks are show. [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] decides to check on the portal located in the pipes of a toilet to see if bread has started being delivered again. There, he finds out the situation has not changed, however, he does notice a shiny shard buried in trash. [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] decides to bring it back to other ducks and showcase his plan. He plans on creating an army of mechs, power the portal with the shard and then attack those who stopped delivering them bread. Multiple welder ducks then proceed working on the [[Ducky D00M III]] and [[Bunny Sentry|Bunny Sentries]]. Sometime in the background, not seen in the cutscene, they also work on a giant [[Nerd Ducky|Mecha Bunny]]. After convincing other ducks to join his cause, he makes a speech to the ducks, which is interrupted by the arrival of the [[Scout]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Soldier]], who arrived here in search of a [[God Cube]] fragment. Their [[God Cube]] fragment locator lead them to the army of ducks that the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] created, where they later get into a battle.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:BathroomApproachOpening.ogg|300px]]
''Calendar is shown, a [[Cool Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Cool Ducky]] can be seen falling.'' {{Color|Ramiel|Skateboard Duck}}: Oh, QUACK! ''Camera moves down to show starving ducks.'' {{Color|Dispatcher|Duck #7334}}: I'm so hungry... {{Color|Dispatcher|Duck #7334}}: Ugh... {{Color|Ramiel|Chunky Duck}}: Bread... {{Color|Titus|Evil Duck}}: WOAH! ''Camera pans over to the toilet.'' {{Color|NerdDuck}}: Hmm... ''Camera is now on the floor, showing [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] walking to the toilet. Afterwards, it moves into the tunnels inside the toilet leading to the portal.'' {{Color|NerdDuck}}: Crud... {{Color|NerdDuck}}: Huh... {{Color|NerdDuck}}: What's, that? ''Now in the bathroom again, where [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] discusses his plan.'' {{Color|NerdDuck}}: I have a plan. {{Color|Analyst|Duck #245}}: Is your plan bread? {{Color|NerdDuck}}: No, but here's what I devised. {{Color|NerdDuck}}: We build an army and use the crystal on the toilet teleporter. {{Color|NerdDuck}}: Then... {{Color|NerdDuck}}: We get bread! ''Camera moves over to the building site, where welder duckies can be seen working on [[Ducky D00M III]] and [[Bunny Sentry|Bunny Sentries]].'' {{Color|NerdDuck}}: It has been too long that we've been left here starving. ''Now shows [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] giving a speech.'' {{Color|NerdDuck}}: We must work together to take our revenge on those who wronged us. {{Color|NerdDuck}}: We must waddle forward. We must fight! {{Color|NerdDuck}}: We must take a stand and take the bread that we- ''Camera moves over to the toilet, showing three [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents coming out of the toilet.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Alright, this should be a simple mission. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Using the key card, it led us to a [[God Cube|god cube]] fragment in a [[Duck Realm|duck realm]]]. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Retrieve it, and return back to base. ''Agents navigate through the bathroom to find the [[God Cube]] fragment, where they encounter a group of ducks.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Oh come on! Even those ducks are using the shard against us!?!? {{Color|NerdDuck}}: Attack!!!
===Soundtracks=== This cutscene has music tracks which can be heard in the background. (Official) Tower Defense Simulator Cutscene Soundtrack - Where is Bread?|First half of the cutscene. (Official) Tower Defense Simulator Cutscene Soundtrack - Is Your Plan Bread?|Second half of the cutscene. ==Ending Cutscene== {| class="empty-table align-center" style="width:800px; margin:0 auto" !Easy !Hard |- |[[File:Ducky Revenge Outro (Easy) - Tower Defense Simulator|400px|thumb|center]] |[[File:Ducky Revenge Outro (Hard) - Tower Defense Simulator Easter 2025 Event|400px|thumb|center]] |} This cutscene plays a couple seconds after finishing Wave 30 in the Easy difficulty or Wave 33 in the Hard difficulty. The cutscene differs based on the difficulty, though the only difference is the mech seen in the cutscene. When the cutscene ends, the match concludes. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
[[T.D.S. Organization]] agents walk up to the destroyed [[Ducky D00M III]]/[[Nerd Ducky|Mecha Bunny]] to retrieve the [[God Cube]] fragment. [[Scout]] walks up to the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], who is confused about his loss, then pulls out a gun and points it at him. [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] then proceeds to beg for his life, which makes the [[Scout]] eventually give up and let him live. [[Professor V]] walks up to [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] impressed by his work, then gives him an offer to work alongside her. [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] agrees, then proceeds to walk with [[Professor V]] and [[Scout]] towards the portal. During the walk, [[Professor V]] informs him that the realm will start receiving bread again.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:BathroomApproachEnding.ogg|300px]]
''Camera shows one of the destroyed mechs having a [[God Cube]] fragment taken out of it. Then, it moves over to the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]].'' {{Color|NerdDuck}}: But... all of my planning... ''Now shows the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents again.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Well, that was more complicated than it needed to be. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Just bring the shard back to base. ''[[Scout]] pulls out a gun and points it at the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]].'' {{Color|NerdDuck}}: Huh? Wait, wait, PLEASE STOP!!! {{Color|NerdDuck}}: I wanted bread! {{Color|NerdDuck}}: Take mercy on me! ''[[Scout]] tries to get himself to kill the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] but eventually ends up not doing it.'' {{Color|NerdDuck}}: Wait, what? {{Color|ProfessorV}}: So, you're the smart one who engineered this all by yourself. {{Color|ProfessorV}}: I think you and I can make a pretty good team. {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Wha'dya say? ''[[Professor V]], [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] and [[Scout]] begin walking back to the portal.'' {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Also, the portal is permanently back on. Your bread should start coming back in now.
